title: MetroOpinion Review – Legit or Scam?(Full Details+Rating)
page_body:
MetroOpinion claims you can easily earn money online and that you can earn up to $5 per survey you answer.
But is MetroOpinion legit, and can it really live up to what it promises, or is it a scam?
Before you join any online rewards site, it is improtant to do research about it, so you’ll know what to expect before you sign up and do not end up wasting your time, as there are many scams out there. 
I have tested this platform thoroughly, and let me just reveal it right away – Yes, MetroOpinion is a legit survey site since it will really pay you for answering surveys.
Now, the question is, is this site really worth your time? 
To answer that, we have to consider several things, and this MetroOpinion review will reveal the full details so you know exactly what to expect and can decide if it is a good fit for you or not.
What is MetroOpinion, and what does it offer?
As mentioned above, MetroOpinion is a survey site that will pay you to answer the surveys they offer. This survey site is powered by  Cint AB , a popular market research company that mainly deals with digital insights gathering.
That it offers these surveys has both advantages and disadvantages. But one advantage is that you know it is backed by a legit company and, therefore, can expect to get paid. 
So you do not have to worry about that part –  it is a real survey site that pays  and not one of the fake scams. 
However, that does not mean it will necessarily be worth your time. To find out more about it, you must know all the details about what it offers.
Now, to understand how MetroOpinion works and what it offers, we first have to take a closer look at the earning opportunity it offers. This should also give you an idea of how well you can earn from the site. 
I have, therefore, made a video that gives you an inside look and shows exactly how you can earn from MetroOpinion. You can also read all the details below the video.
Recommended:  Check Out the Top Survey Sites in Your Country
The earning opportunity – Paid surveys
MetroOpinion only offers one kind of earning opportunity, and that is through paid surveys. When you become a member of their survey panel, you will be invited to participate in surveys from time to time.
There are two ways you can check if there are available surveys you can answer. You can check your email and see if there are survey invites from MetroOpinion, or you can log in to their member dashboard and view all the available surveys.
If you go the email route, you will see a link to the survey and a description of how long it will take and how much you will be credited for completing it in the email you will receive. To answer the survey, you just have to click the link.
If you log in to the member dashboard, you can view all the available surveys in the “Surveys” section. Just choose which survey you want to answer.
When you start answering the survey, you will actually have to provide a bit of basic information about yourself first. Then, you’ll have to answer a set of qualifying questions so the site can determine if you are included in the demographic the survey is intended for.
Survey sites do this to make sure the responses they get will really provide valuable opinions/feedback from the intended audience. If you qualify, you get to answer the actual survey. If you don’t qualify, then you simply move on to the next survey available (if there are any).
Earning from this site is really straightforward. You try to qualify for surveys, and when you do, once you complete it, you will receive the reward promised. The only downside is that if there aren’t any surveys available, you won’t earn any reward.
And, in my experience,  you should not expect too many surveys from MetroOpinion . But more about the full earning potential later.
Recommended:  Check Out the Top Survey Sites in Your Country
How do you get paid?
For every survey you successfully complete, you will earn a certain amount, which will be in the currency of your country (I will discuss later which countries MetroOpinion is available in). 
As mentioned above, the reward will be credited to your MetroOpinion account balance.
They do not have a full overview of the exact methods in each country, but overall, the available methods will depend on your country.
During my testing, the payment options available were gift cards, PayPal, and donations.
The most common payment option seems to be PayPal. But since PayPal is not available in all countries, there will be some places where you can, obviously, not use that.
Before you can withdraw your earnings, though, you will have to reach the payout threshold, and that will also vary depending on your country. The threshold will typically be around $5 to $10 (or the equivalent of that in your local currency).
Once you reach the threshold, you can withdraw your earnings. For PayPal withdrawals, there’s a 2% fee for making the transfer. So,  don’t expect to receive the full amount  when you withdraw your earnings via PayPal.
Their payment method is very straightforward. I like the fact that they offer a convenient payment method like PayPal. If you are interested in more sites that offer a convenient payment method, I recommend you  check out the top sites that pay via PayPal .
But if you live in a country where that is not an option and still prefer getting paid in cash, then you can  check out platforms that pay via Payoneer here .
How much money can you make?
The amount of money you can earn from a MetroOpinion survey will range from $0.50 to $5, which is not a bad rate, in my opinion. However, the issue here is that the site really doesn’t offer a lot of surveys.
Also, be aware that even though you potentially can earn up to $5 per survey, as they claim,  you will very rarely get surveys that pay that much .
Plus, you also have to keep in mind that you won’t earn from every survey you get invited to answer, as you will not qualify for all surveys. So, in my experience, it’s a bit hard to earn regular money from it.
You have no control over how many survey invites you receive. The best thing you can do is to complete your profile immediately to increase your chances of receiving survey invites.
And as you can see in the photo above, there are a lot of profile questions you need to answer. So, you need to set aside a bit of time for this. Also,  you won’t get paid to complete your profile , but it is something you must do if you hope to earn from this site.
Overall, while the site does pay a decent amount for every survey you complete, the earning potential is still quite low since they don’t really offer that many surveys, and they don’t offer any other type of earning opportunity.
So, if there aren’t any surveys available, then you won’t earn anything from this site.
Also, even though you can theoretically earn up to $5 per survey, you need to be aware that  surveys that pay this much will be very rare .
Can you use it on mobile?
MetroOpinion doesn’t have a mobile app you can download, but you can still access their website from a mobile device. You just have to use a mobile web browser.
The good thing is that their site is optimized for mobile use. You will be able to click the links and navigate through the site easily.
 You also don’t have to zoom in to read all the content. So, you will be able to answer surveys from your mobile device with relative ease.
Their site does have a few ads, but not to the point where it becomes spammy. That’s why I would say their website is user-friendly.
Who can join MetroOpinion?
MetroOpinion is only available in specific countries. If you don’t live in any of the countries where it is available, you won’t be able to register.
As you can see in the photo above, it is available in select countries in Europe, North and South America, Asia, Australia, and Africa. 
However, not all countries it is available could fit into the image above, and it is available in a lot more countries than you can see above.
In fact,  it has panels in more countries than most survey sites , so even in countries where it can often be hard to find paid survey sites to join, you will likely be able to join MetroOpinion. And it, of course, also has panels in the countries where there usually are a lot of paid surveys.
To sign up, just choose your country and fill out their registration form.
As mentioned earlier, the currency the site will be using will depend on your country.
Once you are done with the sign-up form, you can log in to the site. I would suggest you complete your profile after this to start the earning process. The sooner you complete your profile, the sooner you will start receiving survey invites.
Can you get support?
If you have any questions about your account or the site in general, you can refer to their FAQ page first. Unfortunately, the FAQ page is no longer available before you join, which is a bit strange, in my opinion. 
If you can’t find the answers you are looking for, then you will have to contact their support team. Unfortunately, their site does not have a contact form you can use, but you can email them at support@metroopinion.com for any questions.
Overall, I would say they have a decent support system in place since they offer a way for you to communicate with their support team.
Final Verdict
MetroOpinion is a legit survey site that will pay you for answering surveys. It has a couple of good features, but it also has some limitations you need to be aware of.
So, let me summarize its pros and cons to wrap up this review. This should give you an overview of what the site has to offer so you can decide if you should join this site or not.
MetroOpinion is not a bad survey site, in my opinion. But it’s not that good, either. It can serve as a decent secondary site to join, provided you set your expectations properly.
You can’t really expect to earn a lot regularly from this site since it doesn't have that many surveys. But if all you really need is an additional survey site, you can join where you can earn extra cash from time to time, then go for it (as long as you are eligible to join, of course).
Now, if you are looking for primary sites to earn from, I would recommend you  check out the top survey and GPT sites in your country  instead. The sites on this list all have good earning potential where you can earn regularly. Plus, you will definitely find a site you can join regardless of where you live.
If you have any comments, questions, or have any experiences with MetroOpinion yourself, I would love to hear from you in a comment belo

title: A Moment in Time: The Week America Loved Trucks-Federal Highway Administration
page_body:
by Richard Weingroff  / FHWA News 2022
We've all seen the 18 wheelers carrying the economy around the country. While we recognize their value, they are not necessarily the most beloved vehicles on the roads. But if you were around before the Interstate System reached far into the countryside, you will recall that truckers once were known as "Knights of the Road" who would help other motorists in need. Further, in the era before fast food franchise restaurants provided exactly the same meals from coast to coast, motorists who wanted to find a good place to eat were advised to look for trucks parked outside – the truckers knew where to find a good, cheap meal. For on-the-road restaurants before the Interstate System, truckers were the Michelin Guide, with their trucks replacing the guide's stars.
Times have changed, as they often do. But there was a moment in time, namely the week of May 17, 1920, when all America celebrated shipping by truck.
America Goes to War
The war in Europe began in August 1914. The issues that resulted in war seemed far removed from most American's concerns, but nevertheless affected many aspects of life, especially international travel. German U-boats began sinking ships in Atlantic waters, a threat that was most dramatically illustrated on May 7, 1915. On that date, a German U-boat sank the RMS Lusitania just 11 miles off the coast of Ireland. As the luxury ship sank, 1,198 people died, including 128 Americans.
President Woodrow Wilson and the Department of State worked through diplomatic channels with the German government to keep the United States out of the war by reducing the threat to American shipping and lives, but whether an agreement could be reached remained uncertain in 1916 when he ran for a second term.
President Woodrow Wilson had an impressive progressive record of domestic achievements, including creation of the Federal Reserve, enactment of Constitutional amendment calling for direct election by people of United States Senators, establishing the Federal Trade Commission, creating the National Park Service, and initiating the Federal-aid highway program. One of his most important campaign themes was that he had kept the country out of the war and would maintain the peace.
President Wilson won re-election by a narrow margin; he went to sleep on election night thinking he had lost. He took the oath of office on March 4, 1917, but by then, circumstances had changed regarding the war in Europe.
Germany announced that beginning February 1, 1917, it would use its submarines to sink every vessel, regardless of flag or character, approaching the country's enemies from the Atlantic Ocean or the Mediterranean Sea. Meanwhile, Germany had secretly reached out to Mexico to seek aid in the war. Upon victory, Mexico's reward would be the return of Arizona, New Mexico, and Texas to its sovereignty. Those threats and other factors changed President Wilson's views.
On April 2, 1917, President Wilson and First Lady Edith Wilson drove through the rain along Pennsylvania Avenue to Capitol Hill to ask Congress for a Declaration of War. "It is a fearful thing to lead this great peaceful people into war, into the most terrible and disastrous of all wars, civilization itself seeming to be in the balance. But the right is more precious than peace . . . ." The Declaration would require "the organization and mobilization of all the material resources of the country to supply the materials of war and serve the incidental needs of the Nation in the most abundant and yet the most economical and efficient way possible."
Congress approved the Declaration on April 7. America's entry into the European or Great War, now known as World War I, would affect every aspect of life in the United States. The country would have to transform itself to win the war, but no one understood just how many aspects of American life would have to change. Surface transportation would be profoundly changed.
Trucks to the Rescue
Learning to Love Trucks
 This truck carried the Firestone message around the country.
The railroads, totaling about 254,000 miles, were the dominant mode of interstate transportation in the country before the war. Dating to the late 19th century, the railroad companies had been strong advocates of the Good Roads Movement because better roads would improve freight access to their stations. But as FHWA's Bicentennial history,  America's Highways 1776-1976 , explained, the railroad companies were "as unprepared for war as the rest of the country – perhaps more so." Because of effective government regulation to preserve competition, "they had been prohibited from pooling freight or from merging parallel competing lines, even where such mergers would have resulted in more efficient systems." A sluggish economy, 1913-1914, had undermined the companies' finances; by the start of the war, "there was a nationwide shortage of about 148,000 cars."
As the war increased the importance of transporting food, freight, munitions, and soldiers, the railroads proved unable to keep up with demand. On December 26, 1917, under Presidential Proclamation 1419, the Federal Government seized all the main steam railroads and set up what became known as the United States Railroad Administration to operate them. Even with government control, the railroads were simply unable to keep up with demand. (The new administration ended on March 1, 1920, and is unrelated to the Federal Railroad Administration created by the Department of Transportation Act of 1966.)
The fledgling Federal-aid highway program, dating to July 1916 and not yet fully implemented, was a casualty of the war. Across the country, personnel for road building were hard to come by, and a shortage of railroad cars, already overburdened by wartime demands, made shipment of materials to road construction projects difficult. Government regulations reduced State and local bond issuances for road building that did not further the war effort.
The Growth of Over-the-Road Trucking
World War I was the first major war where motor vehicles played an important role, replacing the horses and mules of past wars, in the war zone and in the United States. Trucks were a key to victory, and they gained a foothold on interstate transportation of freight they would expand after the war.
President Woodrow Wilson inspecting the initial B Liberty Trucks on the White House grounds.
 On October 1917, the Quartermaster's Department of the Army accepted delivery of the first two class B Liberty Trucks, one built in Rochester, NY, and the other in Lima, OH. The trucks, designed for a 3-ton load but with capacity for 5 tons, arrived in Washington after a 6-day ride of more than 450 miles. At the White House, President Woodrow Wilson (in hat) inspected the vehicles as H. L. Horning, chairman of the Automotive Products Section of the War Industries Board, explained their features. According to a contemporary report, the President "was particularly interested in the short schedule allowed for the design and production of the first truck and in the remarkable record, which even exceeded the scheduled time. The President also was interested to learn that the trucks can operate efficiently on inferior grades of fuel if the necessity arises. He expressed great satisfaction at the promptness with which many manufacturers of the parts responded."
By 1917, the country had 391,000 registered trucks, most engaged in drayage and deliveries in cities. As the railroads proved unable to keep up with freight needs, trucks gradually began to expand service, initially regionally, then on an interstate basis. Interstate roads that could barely accommodate automobile traffic were not designed for heavy trucks or their solid rubber tires. "By August 1917, [rail] car shortages had diverted so much traffic to trucks that the highways began to show signs of distress."
As the European allies had learned before America's entry into the war, large numbers of trucks were needed to support military operations. The War Production Board gradually standardized truck designs to meet wartime needs, with the trucks shipped initially to eastern ports on railroad cars. Beginning in December 1917, to free desperately need rail cars, the Quartermaster General ordered that the trucks should be driven to the coast under their own power. "The first Army truck convoy left Toledo early in December 1917, at the beginning of one of the most severe winters in recent U.S. history. Three weeks later, on January 3, 1918, 29 of the 30 vehicles that began the trip rolled into Baltimore." The successful trip was made possible by the heroic work of crews in Pennsylvania that kept the road open despite a blizzard that ordinarily would have stopped all traffic. In this way, the Army sent 30,000 trucks, each loaded with tons of spare parts and munitions, to the coast during the war.
By war's end, the number of trucks had increased by 199,000 vehicles. Motor carriers established service among the country's main cities. The growth of truck traffic, though tough on the country's inadequate roads, "permanently changed the shipping habits of American industry. In a matter of a few months, the railroads lost millions of tons of freight business by default – business they were destined never to recover." The railroad industry's interest in boosting good roads was at an end.
The war ended with an armistice that went into effect in 1918 on the morning of the "eleventh hour of the eleventh day of the eleventh month." Celebrations erupted around the country. As a headline in  The Baltimore Sun  put it on November 12: "THE WHOLE COUNTRY GOES WILD WITH JOY AT ADVENT OF PEACE." November 11 would be celebrated annually as Armistice Day (renewed as Veterans Day after World War II, first celebrated in 1947).
Shipping By Truck
Harvey S. Firestone
 Harvey S. Firestone, founder of the Firestone Tire & Rubber Company, generated a "Ship-by-Truck" movement around the country after World War I. He was a pioneer in the production of pneumatic tires for cars and trucks, easing the loadings on the country's roads. In 1920, he initiated a promotional "stunt" to hold National Ship by Truck – Good Roads Week on May 17 through 22. He wrote that, "Ship-by-Truck means service – a service founded on facts, resting upon a sound economic basis, and dedicated to the stabilization and advancement of a system of motor transportation which bids fair to accomplish more in the development of our country's natural resources than anything since the coming of the iron horse."
As trucking expanded, Harvey S. Firestone of the Firestone Tire & Rubber Company, generated a "Ship-by-Truck" movement around the country. Truck dealers established Ship-By-Truck associations to encourage trucking for short hauls within a radius of about 50 miles. The associations held truck days or weeks to hold truck parades in the larger cities before sending caravans of trucks around the area to demonstrate

title: 光伏全球“追光”持续“热辣滚烫”财经-中工网
page_body:
原标题：技术创新与国际布局齐步走 ——（引题）
光伏全球“追光”，持续“热辣滚烫”（主题）
进入2月以来，全球各地的太阳能展相继启动。2月6日，西班牙太阳能光伏展在西班牙马德里开幕；2月28日，2024年日本国际太阳能光伏展在日本东京开幕；2月29日，2024第十九届济南太阳能展在山东济南开幕……
江苏光伏企业积极奔赴世界各地参展。数据显示，2023年，江苏光伏企业营收达到约7000亿元人民币，光伏电池产量达到175GW。成绩的背后，是江苏光伏产业在技术创新、产业链整合以及积极拥抱全球化等方面的不懈努力。面对2024年能源转型“热辣滚烫”的市场需求，光伏企业以高质量发展迎接挑战与机遇。
产能过剩，价格下降
最近几天，江苏省光伏产业协会秘书长范国远正在带领团队对《2023江苏光伏产业发展白皮书》做最后的内容核对。从硅料生产到硅片制造，再到电池组件的组装，江苏省拥有完整的光伏产业链，这对提高生产效率，降低生产成本，为产业的可持续发展奠定了坚实基础，夯实了中国光伏企业在国际竞争中的优势地位，为能源绿色低碳转型提供基础保障。
在上海地铁江杨北路车辆段，江苏日托光伏轻柔组件项目布设航拍图。该项目预计年均发电量约410万千瓦时，可减排二氧化碳约3330吨。  （受访者供图）
数据显示，2023年，江苏省内光伏电池产量达到175GW，占全国比重32%。光伏产业的营收和产能实现显著增长。“不仅仅是江苏，2023年国内市场光伏企业的产量与装机量都达到历史峰值。”范国远说。
产量方面，工信部2月28日公布数据显示：2023年全国多晶硅、硅片、电池、组件产量再创新高。多晶硅产量超143万吨，同比增长66.9%；硅片产量超过622GW，同比增长67.5%；全国晶硅电池产量超过545GW，同比增长64.9%；全国晶硅组件产量超过499GW，同比增长69.3%。
装机量方面，国家能源局统计数据显示，全国2023年光伏新增装机量达到216.88GW，为有史以来年度装机量最高值，相当于2022年全球光电装机量总和。截至2023年12月底，太阳能发电装机容量达到610GW，超越水电，成为全国装机量第二大电源形式，在电力能源结构中的地位进一步攀升。
光伏企业的发展步伐也在持续加快。以江苏为例，2023年，全省通过节能评估的光伏项目超50个，总投资额超过1733亿元。
产能扩大，直接推动产品报价下降。2023年年底，硅料价格降至6万—7万元/吨；光伏组件价格较高点已下降1.08元/W，对应组件价格、系统成本降幅达到55%、28%。
“去年光伏原料及组件价格触底。一季度是淡季，市场报价有轻微反弹迹象。”在光伏行业工作近20年的蒋伟说，进入3月，组件端开始试探性涨价，涨幅2—3分/W，头部企业已放出涨价消息。
蒋伟任职嘉环科技股份有限公司新能源事业部总经理，从事光伏电站的开发、建设、运维，长期关注光伏组件等产品的技术发展趋势和市场报价。“一些机构预测，2024年全球安装量预计会超过500GW。”
“面对‘物美价廉’的产品，2024年国内市场、国际市场将释放更多需求。”范国远分析说。不谋而合的是，在隆基绿能最新投资者活动关系调查表中称，从全球范围内看，在当前组件价格不到1元/W情况下，光伏发电成本优势非常突出，进一步驱动全球潜在需求充分释放。
有着“独门绝技”的光伏制造企业从容不迫。“重点企业的排产计划比较满，1月份下单，生产排到3月份，产能利用率非常高。”范国远分析，如阿特斯、天合光能等行业重点企业已实现垂直一体化，其产线从原料到终端，覆盖整个产业链，成本把控精细，原有渠道也非常稳固，足以应对市场价格的波动。
产学研联动，加大技术创新
中国光伏“领跑”全球，核心技术引领行业进入黄金赛道，技术创新是光伏行业发展的最大引擎。
N型TOPCon电池技术以其高效率和低成本的优势，被业内专家认为是未来光伏产业的发展方向。江苏省的光储企业，如天合光能，首次进入“千亿俱乐部”，在这一领域取得显著成果，其研发的N型TOPCon电池转换效率达到行业领先水平。
“未来几年，将出现‘一主两辅一未来’的格局，N型TOPCon电池将是行业主流，HJT和BC为辅助支撑，叠层电池将是创新突破的方向。”天合光能董事长兼CEO高纪凡表示，截至2023年底，天合光能光伏组件全球累计出货量超190GW，天合光能210组件累计出货量超100GW，全球第一。
光伏企业在光伏组件轻量化、柔性化等方面进行大量研究，进一步提高光伏组件性能，拓宽光伏应用场景。“我们以市场需求为导向，实现了垂直领域的技术突破。”江苏日托光伏科技股份有限公司副总裁陈晓忠表示，作为一家创新驱动型的技术企业，日托光伏组件实现“轻柔薄美”的特点，受到全球500多家客户青睐，为分布式光伏市场提供全新解决方案。
南京大学谭海仁教授课题组研制的大面积全钙钛矿叠层光伏组件取得新突破，经国际权威第三方机构测试，其稳态光电转化效率达24.5%，刷新此类组件的世界纪录。目前谭海仁项目组位于苏州常熟的生产基地，正生产标准尺寸的光伏组件，使用了一层钙钛矿技术，明年升级为两层钙钛矿叠加，进一步提升光伏组件效率。
辅助配套设施的技术创新同样关键。中节能太阳能镇江公司研发的光伏清洗机器人，可提高发电收益，降低运维成本。自2014年在行业内率先投入产品研发以来，至去年第五代产品正式上市，已服务近30个大型光伏电站，下一代产品技术升级方向是智能化和数据化。
全球化布局，增强国际竞争力
技术革新在国际竞争中形成比较优势，为中国企业争取到更多订单。2024年一季度是光伏企业传统业务淡季，协鑫集成却连续中标国际国内多个大型订单。
协鑫集成总裁蒋卫朋表示，2023年以来，协鑫集成高效电池组件产能结构实现重大提升，有效保障全球订单的高质量交付，今年一季度以来，协鑫集成持续加强海外订单的开拓，实现新年开门红。“2024年将在全球渠道布局，电池、组件效率提升，新的电池路线研发上继续突破，为全球客户提供高质量的高效组件产品，我们有信心、有能力完成更多挑战。”蒋卫朋说。
对光伏企业来说，全球化拓展势在必行。工信部数据显示，2023年，硅片、电池、组件的出口量有着显著提升，分别同比增长93.6%、65.5%、37.9%。
范国远说，江苏光伏企业出口主要目的地遍及欧洲、南美和东南亚，其中荷兰、巴西、印度、越南和泰国占比靠前，七成是组件。
国际贸易规则不断变化，光伏企业顺势而为，通过建立海外生产基地、参与国际合作项目等方式，提升国际市场竞争力。
近年来，天合光能引进来自66个国家和地区的国际化高层次管理和研发人才，在美国、泰国、越南建立生产制造基地，业务遍布全球170多个国家。
“全球化是天合光能的发展战略，包括构建产能体系、服务体系、经营管理体系、风险管控体系全球化，以满足全球客户的需求。”高纪凡表示。
阿特斯同样重视全球化战略布局。2024年2月28日至3月1日，阿特斯携高效光伏组件、逆变器和储能系统系列产品，亮相日本东京国际太阳能光伏展 PV EXPO。
2月29日阿特斯最新发布显示，阿特斯为美国内华达州拉斯维加斯阿莱金特体育场举行的第58届“超级碗（Super Bowl）”赛事供电方面发挥了关键作用。这是有史以来第一次完全由可再生能源供电的超级碗赛事。
紧随“一带一路”倡议，中节能太阳能镇江公司产品已经销往欧洲、南美、东南亚。今年该公司新成立战略发展部，将通过多个渠道增加企业品牌在海外市场的“出镜率”，发挥央企排头兵作用，扩大企业影响力，增加全球市场占有率，为全球碳达峰碳中和贡献力量。
“从生产端来看，产业链抱团出海是最好的方式，组件、逆变器、支架……产业链出海，附加值和议价能力全面提升。”范国远说，今年将带领协会部分江苏光伏产业链企业共同前往东南亚进行考察。
“欧洲是中国光伏最大的出口市场，但受限于当地专业劳动力不足，大量产品难以全部投入使用。”蒋伟说，这给企业带来了机会，以项目合作的方式，让产品、人才与服务一同出海。
对此，陈晓忠已颇有心得，江苏日托光伏在国内项目中积累有大量轻柔组件产品的施工和技术经验，能快速复制到海外。“从客户视角出发，深入解决问题的本土化出海模式，国内人员还可以远程提供技术支持，国外项目人员学习掌握后，进行现场施工模拟、考核等。”陈晓忠说。（记者 何玥颐 通讯员 苏光伏 吴恺 李杨）

title: 淘宝购物后如何顺利退货？详细步骤解析_商品_卖家_Return
page_body:
淘宝怎么退 (How to Return Items on Taobao)
在中国，淘宝是一个非常受欢迎的在线购物平台，提供了丰富的商品选择。然而，有时候我们可能会因为各种原因需要退货。本文将详细介绍在淘宝上退货的流程和注意事项，帮助你顺利完成退货。
一、了解退货政策 (Understanding the Return Policy)
在进行退货之前，首先要了解淘宝的退货政策。淘宝的退货政策通常包括以下几个方面：
七天无理由退货 ：大部分商品在收到后七天内可以申请退货，无需提供理由。 特殊商品的退货限制 ：某些商品如内衣、食品等，可能不支持无理由退货。 退货运费 ：通常情况下，退货运费由买家承担，但在特定情况下（如商品质量问题），卖家需要承担运费。
在决定退货后，需要准备以下事项：
检查商品 ：确保商品完好无损，附带所有配件和包装。 保留发票和快递单 ：这些是退货时的重要凭证，建议妥善保存。 联系卖家 ：在申请退货之前，可以先与卖家沟通，了解他们的退货政策和要求。
淘宝提供了简单的退货申请流程，具体步骤如下：
登录淘宝账号 ：进入淘宝官网或手机应用，登录你的账号。 找到订单 ：在“我的淘宝”中，找到需要退货的订单。 申请退货 ：点击“申请退货”按钮，填写相关信息，包括退货原因、退款方式等。 提交申请 ：确认信息无误后，提交退货申请。
四、等待卖家确认 (Waiting for Seller Confirmation)
提交退货申请后，卖家会在规定时间内进行确认。卖家可能会要求提供更多信息或照片，以便处理退货请求。此时，建议保持与卖家的沟通，及时回复他们的询问。
五、寄回商品 (Returning the Item) 
一旦卖家确认退货申请，你可以按照以下步骤寄回商品：
选择快递公司 ：选择一个合适的快递公司进行寄送，建议选择有追踪功能的快递。 打包商品 ：将商品妥善打包，确保在运输过程中不会受损。 填写快递单 ：在快递单上准确填写收件人信息，确保卖家能顺利收到商品。 寄出商品 ：将包裹交给快递员，并保留好快递单据，以便后续查询。
商品寄回后，卖家会在收到商品后进行检查。若商品无误，卖家会在规定时间内处理退款。你可以通过以下方式确认退款：
查看退款状态 ：在“我的淘宝”中，查看退款申请的状态。 退款到账 ：一般情况下，退款会在3-7个工作日内到账，具体时间视银行处理速度而定。
在退货过程中，有几个注意事项需要特别关注：
退货期限 ：确保在规定的退货期限内申请退货，逾期可能无法退款。 商品状态 ：退回的商品必须保持原状，任何损坏或缺失都可能导致退款失败。 沟通记录 ：保留与卖家的沟通记录，以备后续需要。
八、常见问题解答 (Frequently Asked Questions)
1. 如果卖家拒绝退货怎么办？ (What to Do If the Seller Refuses to Accept the Return?)
如果卖家拒绝退货，你可以通过淘宝客服进行投诉，提供相关证据，淘宝会介入处理。
2. 退货运费由谁承担？ (Who Pays for Return Shipping?)
一般情况下，退货运费由买家承担，但如果是商品质量问题，卖家需要承担运费。
3. 退货后多久能收到退款？ (How Long Does It Take to Get a Refund After Returning?)
退款通常在卖家确认收到商品后3-7个工作日内到账，具体时间取决于银行处理速度。
4. 退货需要填写哪些信息？ ( What Information Is Needed for Returns?)
退货时需要填写退货原因、退款方式以及快递单号等信息。
5. 可以退换商品的所有类型吗？ (Can All Types of Products Be Returned?)
并非所有商品都支持退换，具体情况请查看商品页面的退货政策。
九、总结 (Conclusion) 
淘宝的退货流程相对简单，但在操作过程中需要注意相关政策和要求。了解退货政策、妥善准备商品、及时申请退货以及保持与卖家的沟通，都是确保顺利退货的关键。希望本文能帮助你在 淘宝购物 时更加顺利，享受愉快的购物体验。内容摘自：http://js315.com.cn/zcjh/203552 .html

title: 商务观察丨东南亚电商市场迎来了最好的时代！
page_body:
东南亚地区的电商市场近年来呈现出蓬勃的发展态势，引起了全球范围内的关注。头部电商平台Shopee、 Lazada 、Tokopedia等快速崛起，带动了整个地区电商市场的活跃度，展现出了巨大的发展潜力。从2015年的50亿美元，飙升到2021年的1200亿美元，预计2025年更是达到惊人的2340亿美元。业内人士认为：“东南亚电商市场正在迎来最好的时代。”
电商
E-Business
市场规模与增长趋势
根据eMarketer发布的报告《2023年全球零售电商预测报告》，2023年东南亚电商市场收入达1139亿美元，增长率为18.6%，远超全球平均水平。数字经济发展势头良好，为电商市场的蓬勃发展提供了坚实基础。
各国电商市场都在快速发展，也为东南亚地区整体经济带来新的增长动力。Lazada，Shopee这些东南亚的电商平台，为新手提供了宽广的销售渠道，还有强大的运营支持，不断完善的服务让东南亚跨境电商越来越完善。但平台的竞争之下是万千商家的内卷。一方面，市场需求的增长和消费者行为的转变为企业提供了广阔的发展空间；另一方面，激烈的市场竞争和不断变化的政策环境也给企业带来了诸多挑战。
电商
E-Business
盘点东南亚的电商平台
东南亚由于门槛低，早已成为商家们的必争之地，且跨境电商品牌众多，各具特色。
Shopee： 作为东南亚最大的电商平台之一，在马来西亚、泰国、新加坡、菲律宾和越南等国家拥有广泛的影响力。其业务范围覆盖广泛，是东南亚地区发展最迅猛的电商平台之一。
Shopee在跨境物流、本地化履约等领域不断优化，推动直播营销模式发展，为客户提供方便安全的支付方式和高效的物流服务。
Lazada： 是东南亚地区最早的电商平台之一，总部设在新加坡。它覆盖了印尼、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡、泰国和越南等多个国家，提供多样化的产品，包括3C电子、家居用品和时尚服饰等。
TikTok Shop ： 2022年下半年开始在东南亚几个国家开放市场。由于TikTok在东南亚拥有庞大的用户群体，TikTok Shop为商家提供了一个全新的销售渠道，尤其适合年轻消费者群体。
Tokopedia ： 印尼最受欢迎的在线电商平台之一，成立于2009年。它专注于满足印尼消费者的多样化需求，提供广泛的商品选择。
除此之外，还有一些其他平台如Amazon、eBay、 Akulaku 等也在东南亚跨境电商市场中占有一席之地。这些平台各具特色，商家可以根据自身产品特点和目标市场选择合适的平台进行入驻。
电商
E-Business
东南亚电商市场步入黄金时期
专家观点认为，2023年被认为是东南亚电商市场的黄金时期，各平台和卖家纷纷涌入该地区，寻求商机。头部电商平台：Shopee、Lazada、Tokopedia等头部平台成为市场主导力量，吸引了中国企业的关注和竞争。新竞争力量的涌入，越来越多的新跨境电商进入市场，加剧了东南亚市场的竞争激烈程度。但随着东南亚经济增长放缓和通货膨胀等不利因素，电商平台面临着更大的竞争压力，Lazada等老牌平台纷纷开启裁员。尽管阿里持续注资，但面临着市场压力和效率提升的挑战。Shopee也进行了员工裁员，以应对市场竞争和效率提升的压力。TikTok Shop 尽管面临监管挑战，但在东南亚市场的增长仍然迅猛，成为头部电商平台的竞争对手。Temu在北美市场表现出色，进入东南亚市场，挑战传统电商平台的地位。
2024年，东南亚电商市场格局或将迎来新的变局，各平台将面临更大的竞争压力和机遇。
电商市场的竞争将持续加剧，平台需要不断调整和创新，以适应市场变化并保持竞争优势。

title: 关税政策调整，Temu 卖家如何借助半托管模式实现降本增效？-搜狐
page_body:
自 2022 年 9 月上线，Temu 凭借独特商业模式与极致低价策略，在全球电商市场迅速崭露头角。其用户数量呈现爆发式增长，在多国应用下载排行榜名列前茅，成为中国供应链产业带基础与全托管模式共同作用下的电商新星。
在全托管模式下，商家仅负责供货，平台包揽选品、定价、物流、仓储及退换货等环节，助力运营能力薄弱的工厂型卖家拓展海外市场。
然而，随着 Temu 不断开拓新市场，问题接踵而至。2024 年初，美国调整关税政策，对中国出口商品加征关税并取消小额包裹关税豁免，后续又额外加征 10% 关税。 这一系列政策使以低价策略为核心的全托管卖家运营成本骤增，陷入提高售价失去优势或维持低价亏本的困境，全托管模式发展受阻。
在此背景下，Temu 半托管模式逐渐兴起，成为跨境卖家关注焦点。半托管赋予卖家更多自主权与灵活性：卖家自主管理海外仓库存，依市场需求和自身情况调整备货；在定价上拥有更大空间，可制定更符合自身利益的价格策略；同时掌控双向物流，优化物流成本，提升配送效率与服务质量，增强买家体验。总之，半托管模式为跨境卖家提供了更广阔发展空间与更多商业机会。
一、Temu半托管模式与全托管模式的区别：
运营责任分配  ： 全托管  ：商家仅负责供货，平台负责选品、定价、物流、仓储、退换货等后续环节。 半托管  ：卖家需自主管理海外仓库存、调整定价以及掌控双向物流等。 定价权  ： 全托管  ：定价权主要在平台，商家对价格的自主调整空间较小。 半托管  ：卖家享有更多自主权，可依市场和自身情况制定价格策略，以获得更多利润空间。 物流与仓储  ： 全托管  ：物流和仓储等环节由平台负责，商家无需过多操心。 半托管  ：卖家要负责海外仓的库存管理及物流安排，虽增加了运营成本，但能缩短配送时间，提升买家体验。 应对关税政策  ： 全托管  ：面对美国等地区加征关税，全托管卖家运营成本骤增，利润空间被压缩，调整空间较小。 半托管  ：卖家可通过自主调整定价和物流策略等，在一定程度上减轻关税政策带来的影响。 运营灵活性  ： 全托管  ：商家运营较为被动，依赖平台的统一运营安排。 半托管  ：卖家可根据市场变化和自身情况，灵活调整运营策略，如快速响应市场需求变化、调整产品线等。 利润空间拓展  ： 全托管  ：利润空间相对固定，主要依赖平台的销售策略和定价。 半托管  ：通过自主定价、优化物流成本等方式，卖家有机会获得更高的利润回报，提升自身的盈利能力和市场竞争力。
二、跨境电商卖家应当如何选择
针对快速变化的海外市场与不断更新的关税政策，指纹科技HICUSTOM通过柔性供应链服务平台与海外仓库直发，为卖家提供全方位服务，有效规避关税风险。
指纹科技旗下的HICUSTOM一站式柔性供应链服务平台，为跨境卖家提供全方位的服务。在半托管模式下，卖家可以利用指纹科技HICUSTOM平台的资源和优势，实现更灵活的运营。平台为卖家提供从选品、设计、生产到物流的一站式解决方案，帮助卖家实现一件代发，降低运营风险。此外，指纹科技 HICUSTOM还提供海外本土货盘的一件代发服务，卖家无需自建海外仓库，即可实现海外本土直发，最快24小时发货，显著提升发货效率。
指纹科技的海外仓库服务为卖家提供了在美国的仓库网络和快速响应的发货能力。通过HICUSTOM的“欧美工厂商品专区”，卖家可以利用其 海外仓实现本地化配送，缩短交付周期，提升客户体验。 这种服务模式不仅降低了卖家的运营成本，还提高了物流效率，使卖家能够更好地应对市场需求的变化。
对于运营能力较弱的小型卖家 ，指纹科技的半托管式服务和海外仓的一件代发服务可以降低运营难度和风险，让他们更容易上手。卖家只需专注于产品选择和市场推广，而将复杂的供应链管理和物流配送交给指纹科技处理。而对于 有一定运营经验和资源的卖家 ，他们可以结合HICUSTOM的柔性供应链，实现更灵活的运营策略，如快速响应市场需求、优化库存管理、提升物流时效等，从而在竞争中占据优势。
总之，指纹科技的半托管式服务和海外仓库为不同类型的卖家提供了多样化的选择，帮助他们根据自身情况和市场需求，找到最适合自己的商业模式，实现业务的持续增长。

title: Return and Refund Laws in the U.S.-TermsFeed
page_body:
Written by
Jocelyn Mackie
 Former civil litigation attorney. Content legal strategist at TermsFeed. 
While the  U.S. does not have federal laws affecting returns and refunds , it's still a good idea to have a Return & Refund Policy, and it will be required in some states if you wish to have control over the terms of your policy.
U.S. state laws do not require a Return & Refund Policy either but  under certain circumstances, you will need to post this policy conspicuously in your storefront or through your ecommerce website . 
Issuing returns and refunds is at your store discretion. However, informing of your policies and maintaining fair terms is expected from your customers.
This article will provide an overview of the laws affecting your Return & Refund Policy in the U.S. and look at some best practices for allowing returns, refunds, and exchanges for merchandise.
Use our  Return & Refund Policy Generator  to generate a Return and Refund Policy for your store. Just follow these steps:
At Step 1, select where your Return & Refund Policy will be used.
At Step 2, add information about your website/app and business.
Answer some questions about your business practices.
Enter an email address where you'd like to receive your Return and Refund Policy and click "Generate."
Done! You'll be able to instantly access and download your new Return and Refund Policy.

What is a Return & Refund Policy
A Return & Refund Policy is a policy that informs customers of the cost, timeframe, and requirements for returning merchandise for a refund or exchange.
This policy also indicates whether a refund is provided as  store credit  or  return of the purchase  price. If there are conditions to securing a return, refund or exchange, the Return & Refund Policy lists those as well. 
Return and Refund Laws in the U.S. termsfeed
A Return & Refund Policy may be included within a Terms & Conditions agreement or be its own fully separate document, occupying its own page on your website.
Retailers also often provide this policy in hard copy with shipments. Most retailers provide the Return & Refund Policy online in FAQ format and in the Terms & Conditions agreement itself.
Stores may create as generous or restrictive of a Return & Refund Policy as they see fit for their business.
Amazon  has a generous Return & Refund Policy that varies based on merchandise type and covers a wide range of items. You can see this in the Table of Contents section of the policy:
Amazon also incorporates the Return & Refund Policy in its "Conditions of Use" agreement. This is  a brief mention  that includes a link to the Return & Refund Policy:
Smaller retailers also take this approach.
thredUP , a used clothing exchange and sales site headquartered in California, includes its Return & Refund Policy in its Terms of Use agreement and in a separate  Support Section  on returns.
This is how thredUP presents its policy on returns in the Terms of Use agreement:
This is the summarized support version of its Return & Refund Policy:
Return & Refund Laws by State
A number of states have passed laws regarding Return & Refund Policies. Some of them are limited to the cancellation of transactions, like hotel or campsite reservations and digital products. Others are primarily focused on assuring consumers see the policy on a website or in a store. 
While no state laws truly require a Return & Refund Policy,  there are circumstances where you need to make your Return & Refund Policy conspicuous  at your storefront and on your website. Each law has guidelines on making this happen. 
Here is what each state requires.
Alabama Return & Refund Policy Laws
According to  Alabama code , a consumer has 7 days after receiving a purchased item to return the item for a refund.
The item must be unused and undamaged. The seller has 30 days to issue a refund or credit.
Alaska Return & Refund Policy Laws
Alaska  offers a  Five Day Cooling Off Rule  that allows consumers to cancel a purchase of over $10 for a refund within 5 days of purchase if the sale took place outside of the seller's formal place of business.
Other than that, for general consumer purchases of goods, the seller can dictate this through a Return and Refund Policy.
Arizona Return & Refund Policy Laws
In  Arizona , retailers can dictate terms of their returns and refunds, but they must conspicuously post them in a Return Policy for their terms to be valid. If the return window offered by the retailer is less than 60 days, this must be clearly noted. All items that are not allowed to be returned must also be clearly noted.
If no Return Policy is posted, the retailer must offer a return for any good purchased within 60 days.
If store credit is issued, it must remain usable for 2 years from the date it is issued. Unless otherwise noted in the Return Policy, the consumer can request the store credit is converted to cash if the consumer cannot find a good use for the store credit within 30 days of it being issued.
Restocking fees must be disclosed if they are to be charged. There are  requirements  for how these fees must be disclosed.
Arkansas Return & Refund Policy Laws
In  Arkansas , the terms of the retailer's Return and Refund Policy are upheld.
California Return & Refund Policy Laws
Civil Code Section 1723  of the California state requires a retailer to post their Refund Policy  if the policy contains unique requirements . For example, requirements that wouldn't be expected by an average consumer.
Common expectations in the U.S. for retailers' offerings include:
A full cash or credit refund An exchange Or a combination of these solutions when buyers are unsatisfied with their purchase
If the Return & Refund Policy does not include these expectations,  it must be conspicuously displayed , even it only applies to one class of merchandise. 
For example, if a retailer only authorizes exchanges but not refunds, that would need to be displayed.
Likewise, if returns are not authorized on particular merchandise, like medical items, that must also be displayed. 
If the display of the policy is necessary, the Return & Refund Policy must state:
Whether a cash refund, store credit or exchange is given for the full purchase price The time period a refund, credit or exchange is authorized Merchandise covered by the policy, and Conditions for a refund, credit or exchange. For example, that is must have the receipt and original packaging
Exceptions to this policy include perishable items, merchandise marked "as is," goods damaged after purchase, customized goods that meet specifications, merchandise without its original packaging, and exchanges that cannot be made due to public health reasons. 
Colorado Return & Refund Policy Laws
In  Colorado , retailers can dictate terms of their returns and refunds.
Connecticut Return & Refund Policy Laws
Connecticut  law allows retailers to set their own Return & Refund Policy terms. The only requirement is that  they display the policy in a conspicuous place .
If the Return & Refund Policy is not displayed or the retailer does not have a Return & Refund Policy, the buyer is entitled to a refund in the amount of the purchase price. 
Retailers are not obligated to provide a refund without proof of purchase. 
Connecticut law does not apply to perishable items, plants, custom-made goods, used items, and those that cannot be resold due to state regulations.
Merchandise marked "as-is" or "final sale" also fall under these exceptions. 
Delaware Return & Refund Policy Laws
In  Delaware , retailers can dictate terms of their returns and refunds.
District of Columbia Return & Refund Policy Laws
In the  District of Columbia , retailers can dictate terms of their returns and refunds.
Florida Return & Refund Policy Laws
The law in  Florida  only concerns retailers who will not issue refunds. If your store policy is a "no refunds" policy, Florida statutes require you to clearly state this conspicuously near store entrances or the cashier's station.

title: Temu美国卫衣退货怎么处理？有支持退货质检的海外仓吗？-网易
page_body:
近年来，随着Temu在美国市场的迅速扩张，中国跨境卖家迎来了新的流量与增长机会。然而，随着销量攀升，退货问题也随之凸显，尤其是在服装类目中，卫衣、T恤、外套等时尚品类成为退货率最高的品类之一。对于入驻Temu半托管的中国卖家而言，如何高效处理美国消费者的退货、质检与再销售，已经成为影响利润与运营效率的关键环节。
Temu在美国的崛起与挑战
根据分析机构Similarweb与Sensor Tower的数据，Temu自2022年9月进入美国市场后，仅一年多时间便稳居美国App Store购物类榜首。截至2024年，Temu在美国的月活跃用户已超过1.2亿，成为继亚马逊和沃尔玛之后，美国最受欢迎的购物平台之一。
美国市场的服饰类产品一直是Temu最热销的品类。根据Statista数据，美国服装市场规模在2024年已达3580亿美元，其中休闲服饰（包括卫衣、连帽衫）占比超过30%。然而，这一品类同时也是退货的“重灾区”。美国国家零售联合会（NRF）数据显示，2023年美国整体线上购物退货率为17.6%，其中服装类退货率高达25%—35%。
消费者退货的原因多种多样：尺码不符、颜色差异、质感不符合预期等，都让卖家在售后环节面临巨大压力。对Temu卖家而言，这意味着不仅要处理海量退件，还要承担高昂的跨境退运费用与复杂的清关流程。
Temu半托管卖家的退货困境
传统的跨境退货方式通常是“退回国内”，但这样的操作周期往往长达30-60天，运输成本甚至超过货值本身。此外，退货商品往往需要重新质检、包装甚至换标，才能再次销售。如果卖家无法及时处理，就可能造成库存积压和资金流压力。
因此，如何在美国本地实现退货接收、质检、二次上架，成为越来越多Temu卖家关注的核心问题。
优时派美国退货仓：解决Temu半托管卖家退货难题
针对这一痛点，优时派凭借多年跨境逆向物流经验，在美国布局了完善的退货仓网络，帮助Temu卖家快速、高效、低成本地完成退货全流程处理。
美东与美西双仓布局，退货处理高效稳定
优时派在美东（新泽西）与美西（洛杉矶）均设有大型退货仓：
新泽西退货仓面积达7250平方米，具备日均20000+件处理能力，辐射美东及中部主要消费市场；
洛杉矶退货仓同样拥有7250平方米仓储空间，日均可处理10000+件退货订单，有效覆盖美西及太平洋沿岸地区。
两地仓库均配备叉车、轻重型货架、消防监控与24小时CCTV安保系统，保障货品安全。同时，优时派的仓库操作团队由美国当地华人团队执行、中国管理团队统筹，实现跨国协同与流程标准化。
退货质检+二次上架：让卫衣退货“变资源”
卫衣类商品在退货后往往仍具再销售价值。优时派美国退货仓为Temu卖家提供专业的退货质检、熨烫整形、重新包装、贴标换标及二次上架服务，帮助卖家最大化利用退回库存。
良品可直接在美国市场重新上架销售，减少跨境往返运输的成本与时间；而存在轻微瑕疵的产品，也可通过维修、翻新、贴标等方式再次流通，从而降低损耗。
优时派的退货质检时效平均仅为2天，退货物流时效3-5天即可完成，大幅缩短整体售后周期，让Temu卖家可以更快恢复销售。
系统化管理，退货全程可视化
优时派自主研发的退件管理系统（OMS）与仓储管理系统（WMS），可实现退件状态的实时追踪与可视化管理。卖家可在线查看每一件退货商品的质检、处理及去向信息，保障流程透明可控。
一站式美国跨境物流服务
除了退货服务外，优时派还提供头程运输、仓储、一件代发等美国本地跨境物流解决方案，帮助Temu卖家构建完整的供应链闭环。卖家无需再与多家物流供应商对接，即可完成从发货到退货的全流程管理，显著降低运营成本与管理复杂度。
退货处理不再是负担，而是机会
Temu平台的高速发展意味着更多商机，也带来更高的售后挑战。对于在美国市场销售卫衣等服饰类产品的卖家而言，退货处理效率已直接影响到品牌口碑与利润空间。
优时派通过专业的美国退货仓网络、完善的质检与系统化操作，为Temu半托管卖家提供了一套行之有效的解决方案。让退货不再是成本，而是可重新转化的库存资产。
面对旺季来临与退货高峰，选择优时派，让每一次退货都能“退”得高效、“返”得有价值。

title: 对话Cindy Tai：跨境电商从外贸新业态到新常态
page_body:
04:37
过去几年，出口跨境电商行业不断发展，为企业带来了前所未有的全球化发展机遇。2015年，亚马逊全球开店开始布局中国。五年间，亚马逊中国卖家群体不断发展，成为亚马逊全球消费者提供优质选品的重要力量之一。
2020年，突发的疫情让人们的工作和生活都受到了不同程度的影响。线上购物作为较为安全的购物方式之一，获得越来越多消费者的青睐，也为出口跨境电商行业带来新的机遇与挑战。
亚马逊全球副总裁、亚马逊全球开店亚太区负责人Cindy Tai(戴竫斐)在接受媒体采访时表示：过去几年，中国的出口跨境电商行业不断发展，逐渐从野蛮生长逐渐走向精耕细作。未来，随着数字化转型的推进，跨境电商也将进一步发展，并逐步从外贸出口的“新业态”成长为 “新常态”。
同时，Cindy Tai还建议中国卖家需要更加关注产品创新与差异化、重视品牌打造，中国传统企业要加快转型步伐，以把握“后疫情”下的发展机遇，并在亚马逊上取得长期发展。
亚马逊全球副总裁、亚马逊全球开店亚太区负责人 Cindy Tai
以下为与亚马逊全球副总裁Cindy Tai的对话实录。
Q: 能否简单介绍下亚马逊全球开店以及全球开店的业务模式？
Cindy Tai：亚马逊全球开店致力于帮助全球的卖家通过跨境电商的渠道，借助亚马逊的全球站点和资源，把产品销售给全球消费者和企业与机构客户。
目前，亚马逊全球的第三方卖家的销售额已经占亚马逊站点总销售额的近60%。一直以来，我们不断帮助中国卖家拓展跨境电商业务。2015年，在中国成立“全球开店”团队，五年来，亚马逊陆续向中国卖家开放了全球14大海外站点，让卖家能够直接触达亚马逊全球超过3亿活跃用户，其中包括1.5亿Prime会员用户，以及数百万企业与机构客户。
我们也在不断加强本地化服务、为中国卖家提供本地化的服务。同时，通过宁波、杭州、厦门的“跨境电商园”，持续加深在中国的区域布局，并推出“101･时代青年计划”，满足跨境电商发展人才需求。
Q: 此次，亚马逊全球开店发布《从新业态到新常态——中国出口跨境电商趋势报告》，能否为我们介绍下发布此项报告的初衷？
Cindy Tai：五年间，我们看到亚马逊中国卖家群体不断发展，见证了中国出口跨境电商行业从“野蛮生长”到“精耕细作”的演变。在今年，疫情的持续影响加速全球消费者购物模式从线下转到线上，这给卖家带来了新的机遇和挑战。
我们期望通过报告对五年来中国出口跨境电商行业和中国卖家发展趋势的梳理，为行业提供启发与借鉴，帮助更多企业把握“疫情新常态”下的发展机遇。
Q:您在跨境电商行业深耕多年，能否跟我们分享一下中国卖家在出口跨境领域面临哪些挑战？
Cindy Tai：中国卖家在跨境电商领域具有独特的优势，中国有强大的制造业和供应链基础，中国制造企业巨大、灵活的生产规模和效率以及完善的产业链形成了“中国制造 ”的优势。
但是，中国企业在进一步拓展跨境电商业务时面临诸多挑战。
首先，跨境电商实现端到端的贸易模式，让消费者从“终端”站到了贸易链的最“中心”。这就要求企业必须有能力通过消费者的反馈和实时数据，快速地进行产品研发创新、升级迭代。
第二是品牌的打造。跨境电商的崛起让企业能够以轻量化投入、数据化运营实现高效打造全球品牌，但对于传统外贸企业及代工工厂而言，这方面的能力需要提升。
第三，企业要思考如何做多站点布局。借助跨境电商，企业能快速布局多个国家的业务，降低对单一市场的依赖和风险。这就要求中国卖家必须要具备更为完善的多站点运营能力。
Q：您刚才提到，过去几年中国卖家从“野蛮生长”转向“精耕细作”，在这个演变中您观察到了哪些特征？
Cindy Tai：在出口跨境电商发展的初期，中国的卖家主要是依靠制造成本的优势跳过中间环节，借助亚马逊世界各地站点，直接把产品销售给全球消费者。那时候，大部分卖家来自贸易商，主要以价格优势赢得消费者。过去几年来，随着行业持续发展中国卖家不断转型、升级。
首先，卖家类型日益多元，从最早以贸易商为主，现在新兴品牌不断涌现，传统制造商、国内知名品牌 ，都加入到出口跨境电商的行业中。
其次，卖家所在地域持续拓展，从珠三角，到今天长三角、福建、中部地区以及北部地区。
第三，中国卖家能力及所提供选品品质持续提升，更加关注客户体验、产品质量与创新，关注运营的合法合规，为更好长期发展打下基础。
最后，卖家也持续加速多站点布局，从最初仅专注在北美的站点，到拓展欧洲、日本，包括亚马逊新兴站点像中东、澳大利亚、新加坡等 。
Q：我们刚刚讲到这些年来，许多不同类型、不同规模的中国卖家在亚马逊都取得了成功，这其中有哪些您印象比较深刻的卖家故事。
Cindy Tai：我想为大家分享两个案例。
第一个是安克。安克被称为“跨境电商圈的神话”，是典型随亚马逊全球开店成长起来的企业。安克在行业初期就开始自己的品牌之路，致力于在全球塑造不一样的中国消费电子品牌。安克非常专注于产品的研发和设计，每年都大量投入。也正因此，安克的多款产品成为了亚马逊上的爆款。举例来说，安克有一款数据线能够拉动1.5吨的小汽车，其充电产品也被用户称为“充电神器”。
第二个是Orolay。Orolay是一个羽绒服品牌，产品设计时尚、实用性强，且价格优惠，在亚马逊该品类内销量第一。Orolay最显著的特点是始终将客户需求放在首位，持续根据消费者反馈升级产品，不断对衣服进行改版，包括大小、颜色，甚至口袋的位置等等。此前，在多家美国主流媒体的报道中称Orolay羽绒服为“Amazon Coat”。
Q：今年以来的疫情对世界经济产生了不小的冲击。能否分享下疫情对出口跨境电商发展带来了哪些变化、产生了什么样的影响？
Cindy Tai：最为明显的是，疫情期间全球消费者购物行为大量从线下转到线上。我们认为，这种消费行为的转变将持续下去。这给出口跨境电商企业带来新的挑战与机遇。
今年以来，在国家的倡导与支持下，一系列“稳外贸、保增长”的举措出台实施，包括开设更多综试区、推出新的海关监管模式等。这些举措让更多企业享受到国家政策的支持与利好，对行业的长期发展有很大帮助。
所以，以往我们说出口跨境电商是外贸的“新业态“。但随着消费者加速从线下转到线上的购物行为，我们认为，跨境电商，将成为外贸的“新常态”。
Q：疫情爆发期间，亚马逊做了哪些努力？如何帮助和支持卖家度过这个困难时期？
Cindy Tai：面对亚马逊全球客户，疫情期间我们和许多公司一起为客户提供必要的服务。
面对卖家，我们及时调整策略、推出举措，帮助卖家共渡难关。在运营上，及时提供政策更新和指导；在费用上，及时减免服务费及部分库存和仓储费用；在物流方面，针对医疗用品、生活必需品等高需求选品上面，推出跨境物流包机，及时补货、发货；在人才方面，启动时代青年计划“云招聘会”和“实习实训”两大新项目，推动跨境电商人才校企对接，帮助企业复工复产。
Q：当下，中国卖家应该如何把握“后疫情”下出口跨境电商发展机遇？您有哪些建议？
Cindy Tai：首先，卖家要更加关注产品创新与差异化。在亚马逊运营，客户体验与产品品质永远是第一位的。卖家要不断提升借助消费者反馈持续升级产品的能力，并适应不同地区消费需求。这样才能从行业初期所形成的成本价格优势提升到产品质量和创新优势。
第二，卖家要更加重视品牌打造，加深对品牌的理解和关注，提升全球消费者提供的品牌体验，以进一步增强在全球市场中的长期竞争力。
第三，中国传统企业必须要加快转型步伐。包括制造企业、传统外贸企业都要有紧迫感，坚定拓展新渠道的决心、加速转型。
最后，是多站点布局。我们的企业要具备关注全球商机的视野和决心和加强多站点运营的能力 。
Q：下一步，亚马逊将怎样帮助中国企业布局全球，怎样帮助中国传统外贸企业实现数字化转型？
Cindy Tai：首先，持续亚马逊在卖家平台和工具方面的创新和投入，帮助卖家更高效的运营和管理全球业务。
第二，持续拓展和完善亚马逊在全球的物流体系，帮助卖家为全球客户提供快速优质的配送服务。
第三，进一步拓展帮助企业打造全球品牌的工具和方案。
第四，继续为不同类型企业提供更多元的业务模式和商机。如亚马逊企业购（Amazon Business）业务就为许多传统企业提供了全球线上商业采购的业务机会。
最后，我们将持续加深本地化服务，包括进一步拓展亚马逊全球开店团队在中国的覆盖区域，与各地高校开展人才合作，并继续加深与政府、行业合作，共同帮助传统企业拓展新的外贸渠道。比如，7月初我们与浙江省商务厅签署合作备忘录，推出“新外贸扶持计划”，携手帮助浙江省50多个产业带传统外贸企业转型升级。
我们希望，通过这些努力，能帮助中国各类型的优质企业，成功的发展出口跨境电商业务。

title: 美国5大互联网公司2024Q3财报：Amazon广告收入同比增长最高，eBay净利润腰斩-百家号
page_body:
文 | Colin 制图 | Moggi
近日， Amazon、Alphabet、Meta、eBay、Snap等海外互联网 巨头陆续公布了2024年第三季度财报，Morketing查阅了所能找到的财报文件，并将相关数据整理成图表。今天我们就来盘点下上述5家互联网企业在今年第三季度的营收表现。
从财务数据整体来看， Alphabet（Google） 的广告收入依然是最高，达到了658.54亿美元，领先排名紧随其后的Meta接近一倍的广告营收，相较其他互联网巨头，eBay的广告营收相对较低，仅为4.08亿美元。
不过以同比增长来看的话又是另一幅光景，在营收的同比增长上， Amazon 处于领跑态势，同比增长19%，Meta紧随其后，同比增长18.7%；eBay同比增长11%，略低于前面两家，而 Alphabet和Snap在广告营收上的同比增长则接近持平。
在广告收益在总营收的占比中，Meta以98.3%的占比排在首位，排在第二位的Snap广告业务在整体营收中的占比为91%， Alphabet的整体营收中，广告业务占比74%，而在Amazon和eBay的整体营收中，广告业务的占比分别为8%和2.2%。
纵观2024年第三季度全球几大互联网公司由广告业务所带来的收益不难发现，均呈现增长趋势，此外，AI技术正在快速的渗透进企业的日常生产经营环节中，比如利用AI技术赋能品牌快速生成符合用户兴趣的广告、借助AI对投放策略进行优化调整等等，也因此，上述六家企业中的多家企业，不约而同的在财报中或在随后的电话分析会上，对AI有所提及，并对AI对广告业务的助益寄予厚望。谷歌首席执行官桑达尔・皮查伊在公司 2024 年第三季度财报电话会议上表示：“AI 新功能正在扩展人们的搜索方式和内容。在云计算领域，AI 解决方案帮助吸引新客户并赢得更大规模的交易。”
Amazon AWS：云业务营收和利润率双增长
11月1日，Amazon发布了2024年Q3财报。财报数据显示，Amazon Q3净销售额为1588.77亿美元，同比增长11%；净利润为153.28亿美元，同比增长55%。 结合过往亚马逊的表现，Q3营收和净利润虽有增幅却难言显著，但即便如此，这份财报仍给予了投资者较大的信心，盘后交易中，亚马逊股价一度大涨。
结合Amazon本季财报数据来看，Q3 Amazon的营收中，零售仍是重要组成部分，以电商业务为例，财报显示，Q3在线商店净销售额为614.1亿美元，同比增长7.2%，在增速上超过2024Q2的4.58%的增速以及2024Q1的6.99%增速。
在广告业务上，Q3的净销售额为143亿美元，同比增长19%，虽然呈现出良好的增长态势，但相较Q2和Q1的19.5%和24%的增速，出现了一定的放缓。
作为Amazon盈利能力最强、利润率最高的部门，AWS云计算业务在Q3在营收和利润率两项上都实现了突破性的增长。在Q3，AWS净销售额为274.5亿美元，同比增长19%，高于前两季度的18.7%（Q2）和17.25%（Q1），这也意味着AWS云业务在营收同比增速上，已经实现了连续5个季度的增长。
在利润率上，据财报显示，Q3 AWS云业务营业利润达104亿美元，在公司整体的营业利润中占比近60%，此外，营业利润率为38.1%，再创新高。
对于AWS利润率增长的原因，亚马逊方面表示，主要源于收入加速增长与成本效率提升，服务器使用寿命的延长，以及人力资源优化与基础设施成本管理等因素。
综合来看，AmazonQ3获得超预期增长，主要归功于云业务和广告业务，并且在AI的加持下，这种增长趋势或将也得以延续，在财报电话会议上，虽然亚马逊CEO Andy·Jassy虽然并未透露AI对AWS业务的具体影响，但也提到，“生成式AI已经创造了数十亿美元的收入，并且正在以三位数的同比增长率增长”。
同时，他指出“亚马逊云计算业务AWS取得了成功，尽管建设数据中心的成本极高，但该业务已成为一个至关重要的利润引擎。
Alphabet（Google）搜索广告业务仍是营收最大功臣
10月30日，谷歌母公司Alphabet公布2024年Q3财报，盈利超出预期。Q3营收882.7亿美元，去年同期为766.93亿美元，同比增长15%。季度净利润263.01亿美元，上年同期为196.89亿美元。Q4Google广告营收658.54亿美元。
显然即便ChatGPT席卷全球下，也暂时未能在AI搜索领域对Google造成严重的冲击。Google的广告业务保持着稳定的增长态势，这一点从Q3财报中的广告收入组成中可以略知一二，其中，搜索广告收入为493.9亿美元，同比增长12.2%；YouTube广告收入为89.21亿美元，同比增长12.2%，此外，订阅、平台和设备收入也有显著增长，同比增长27.8%。Morketing Global乐观预测，随着Google 推出新的 YouTube 广告后，将会有更多广告主涌入。
同时，从财报数据看，被视为未来增长引擎的Google Cloud实现了迅猛增长，收入113.5亿美元，同比增长约35%，此外，Google Cloud营业利润约19.5亿美元，同比增长632%，远高于分析师预期的11.1亿美元。
显然，在Google Cloud增长的背后与AI技术的推动息息相关，正如Alphabet兼谷歌CEO Sundar Pichai在财报的公告中所说，“在搜索方面，我们新的 AI 功能正在扩展人们的搜索范围和搜索方式。在云端，我们的AI解决方案正在帮助现有客户更深入地应用产品，并吸引新客户，以及赢得更大的交易。”
同时， Sundar Pichai表示，公司长期专注并投资于AI，正在通过消费者与合作伙伴受益于AI工具而获得回报。
从财报来看，Google整体表现稳中有增，同时三季度盈利超出预期。最值得关注的还是Google Cloud实现了35%的强劲增长，AI技术还会对其未来的业务增长注入哪些新的动能，值得期待。
Meta（Facebook）广告业务实现增长，
但亚太地区承压
10月31日，Facebook母公司Meta公布2024年第三季度业绩。季度营收405.89亿美元，上年同期为341.46亿美元，同比增长20%；净利润为156.88亿美元，较上年同期的115.83亿美元增长35%。
其中，三季度广告业务的营业收入为398.85亿美元，与去年同期的336.43亿美元相比实现18.7%的增长，在公司整体的营收中占比98.3%，从广告收入的增长上，高于同期谷歌广告业务15%的增长。
尽管广告业业务在公司整体营收中仍扮演着举足轻重的地位，且保持了强劲的增长，但在财报中也可以看到，在细分地区中的亚太地区，广告业务的增长有所放缓，上季度的增速为28%，本季度仅为15%。
对于亚太地区广告业务增长的放缓，Meta首席财务官SusanLi将其归结于中国广告商需求的减弱。值得注意的是，此前包括Temu和Shein等公司的崛起，曾在一段时间内引发投资者对于新崛起的平台是否会为Meta收入造成冲击的担忧。
增速放缓的同时，应用月活也在增长上出现放缓。据Meta披露的Q3财报显示，各应用程序家族（包括Meta、 Instagram、WhatsApp和Messenger等服务）的日活跃用户数（DAP）在9月份平均为32.9亿，虽实现了同比5%的增长，但仍不及分析师此前预期的33.1亿。
eBay 营收微增，但净利润接近腰斩
10月31日，eBay发布2024年第三季度财报，报告显示，eBay第三季度净营收为25.76亿美元，同比增长3%；净利润为6.36亿美元，相较去年同期来自于持续运营业务的净利润 13.06 亿美元，大幅下降51%。
eBay第三季度总商品交易额（GMV）为183.06亿美元，与去年同期的179.91亿美元相比增长2%。在美国本土市场，第三季度来自于美国的总商品交易额为87.40亿美元，与去年同期的86.38亿美元相比增长1%；来自于国际市场的总商品交易额为95.66亿美元，与去年同期的93.53亿美元相比增长2%。
对于广告业务，在财报中，eBay方面提到，eBay推出了重新设计的全球广告平台，统一和简化了体验，并赋予卖家以工具，以更好地实现其广告目标，在Q3 eBay 的第一方广告产品实现了 3.96 亿美元的收入，按报告口径增长 15%，按 FX-Neutral 口径增长 14%。第三季度广告收入达4.08亿美元，占GMV的2.2%。
综合财报数据整体来看，广告业务仍为整体收入注入新的增量，但销售和营销支出的逆势增长，达到5.92亿美元，同比增长4.4%，也进一步稀释了eBay的净利润。
Snap 广告收入同比增长10%，
净亏损大幅收窄
10月30日，科技公司 Snap发布 2024年第三季度财报，报告显示，公司旗下通讯应用Snapchat用户规模持续增长，全球日活用户（DAU）达到4.43亿，较上一年同期增加3700万。公司第三季度营收达到13.7亿美元，同比增长15%，超过华尔街分析师预期。
净亏损为1.5亿美元，较上年同期的净亏损3.7亿美元大幅收窄;调整后的息税折旧摊销前利润(EBITDA)为1.3亿美元，同比增长229%;调整后的每股收益为0.08美元，好于分析师平均预期的0.05美元。
值得一提的是，在Q3，Snap来自于北美、欧洲以及其他地区的营收，都呈现增长态势。其中，北美地区的营收为8.58亿美元，与去年同期的7.86亿美元相比增长9%；欧洲地区的营收为2.49亿美元，与去年同期的2.00亿美元相比增长24%；世界其他地区的营收为2.66亿美元，与去年同期的2.02亿美元相比增长32%。
在广告收入上，Snap公司在2024年第三季度的广告收入为12.5亿美元，同比增长了10%。其中，效果广告（Direct Response Advertising）收入同比增长了16%，品牌导向的广告收入则下降了1%。
Snap首席执行官Evan Spiegel表示：“我们在人工智能和增强现实方面的投资正在为我们的社区提供新的创意体验，并推动我们广告平台的创新，巩固我们的长期增长机会。”

title: 政策扶持“中国制造”走出去，跨境出口电商运营方式多样化
page_body:
经济全球化是世界经济发展的必然结果,也是全球经济发展的重要特征。在经济全球化的背景下,电子商务实现了跨越式发展,中国电商商务规模占据全球电商市场一半份额以上。
全球其它国家电商市场也都在迅猛发展,特别是东南亚的新兴市场呈现出，的发展态势。
对比国内电商已经趋于饱和的市场来说,目前跨境电商就像十年前的国内电商还处于蓝海市场,选择跨境电商相对收益高,风险小,海外市场对我国的产品需求旺盛,国际发展空间潜力巨大,那么从业者只需要在国内找到适合自己销售模式的货源就能迅速开展业务把商品卖到世界各地。
跨境出口：海外市场广阔，政策扶持“中国制造”走出去
适应消费需求，跨境出口电商运营方式多样
（1）跨境出口电商B2B模式占比较高，B2C模式增速较快
B2B模式:(business to buesiness)商家对商家进行交易。
跨境出口电商B2B 分两大运营模式：信息服务平台和交易服务平台。
B2C模式:(business to consumer)商家对个人进行交易。
跨境出口电商B2C 分三种运营模式：平台模式、自营模式和第三方模式。
2019 年跨境出口 B2C 模式交易规模1.7 万亿元，增速23.6%。
（2） 海外仓模式成为跨境出口新常态
跨境出口电商的物流模式主要有两种：国际物流模式和海外仓模式。
海外仓模式可以解决时效、成本、清关及本土化等问题。
海外仓发展迅速，成为跨境出口新常态。
不同出口目的地的线上消费者对于物流有不同的偏好，如亚洲地区的消费者更追求速度，而非洲的消费者更看重运费成本。
需求端：海外电商渗透率提升空间大，疫情催化消费习惯转变
全球电商销售市场规模2021 年将达 4.9 万亿美元，复合增速20.8%。
主要目的地国家电商市场渗透率逐年提升，且仍有较大提升空间。
海外疫情催化销售向线上迁移。
供给端：“中国制造”的产业支撑+政策持续性利好
3C 电子产品、服装服饰类产品占据跨境出口电商优势地位。
中国卖家大多数来自珠三角、长三角，具备低成本、高效率、柔性供应链优势。
政策端：国务院、海关总署、财政部、商务部、外汇管理局、国家税务总局等政府部门给予跨境出口电商企业一系列优惠、便利措施的组合。
跨境出口相关公司梳理
安克创新（A股上市）
（1）公司简介
安克创新是全球知名消费电子行业跨境出口品牌商，以自有品牌电子产品的自主研发、设计和销售为主营业务。公司由阳萌贺丽共同持股47.4%，是安克创新的实际控制人。
（2） 公司销售业务以线上B2C为主，深耕亚马逊等第三方电商平台
公司专注于智能配件和智能硬件的设计、研发和销售业务，深耕亚马逊等线上B2C 电商平台，业务覆盖全球主流线上市场，同时积极拓展线下渠道。
公司销售形式多样，业务涵盖境内外线上线下，以境外销售为主，占主营业务收入的98.5%。
公司主要通过亚马逊、eBay、天猫和日本乐天等境内外主流的第三方平台实现产品在全球范围内的线上 B2C销售业务。
（3）公司电子产品品类丰富，北美、欧洲是主要目标市场
公司销售产品主要来自Anker、Soundcore、Eufy 等自研品牌。
公司产品主要出口销往北美、欧洲、日本、中东等经济发达、消费力强的地区，在当地拥有很高的市占率和美誉度。
仓储物流上，公司在国内设有普通仓和保税仓，在美国、日本、欧洲等境外地区租赁本地仓库，辅以平台销售使用的亚马逊FBA 仓。
（4） 公司盈利能力能力优秀，偿债能力强
2016-2019 年公司总营业收入由25.1 亿元增至66.5 亿元，CAGR 达38.6%；归母净利润由2.3 亿元增长至 7.2 亿元，年均复合增速46.4%。
星徽精密（A股上市，子公司泽宝技术）
（1）泽宝：“精品”经营策略，跨境出口电商领先者
泽宝技术是中国跨境电子商务零售行业的先行者和领先者，2018 年 12 月星徽精密以整体对价15.3 亿元完成对泽宝技术100%股权收购。
泽宝股份是一家国内领先的“互联网+”品牌型产品公司，定位于“精品”路线，在亚马逊等电商平台开立店铺从事 B2C 业务，垂直化、精细化的运营模式。
（2）公司销售业务以线上B2C为主，深耕亚马逊平台
以B2C 出口为主，占出口收入90%以上，其余为线下B2B 出口；B2C 出口依赖亚马逊平台实现销售，占B2C 出口收入99%以上，属于相对传统的跨境出口B2C 卖家模式。出口市场上，公司积极布局全球扩张战略。
（3）公司坚持精品路线精益求精，发展自有品牌
公司专注于自有品牌建设，拥有技术加持赋能品牌，已形成RavPower、TaoTronics、VAVA、Anjou、Sable、HooToo 六大品牌的品牌矩阵。收入上，以电源、蓝牙音频、小家电、电脑手机周边、个护健康为主。
（4）FBA模式保证高效物流
仓储物流上公司使用亚马逊FBA 仓储和物流服务，同时发展自有仓。
（5） 公司营业收入持续提高，盈利能力仍有提升空间
2016-2019 年公司总营业收入以及归母净利润保持高速增长的趋势，2019 年毛利率为50.5%，其他年份未披露。
焦点科技（A股上市）
焦点科技：多年深耕外贸B2B 电子商务平台中国制造网，享有优秀的行业知名度和领先地位，是全球贸易商寻求中国供应商的首选平台之一。
（1） 公司简介与发展脉络
焦点科技是国内综合型第三方B2B 电子商务平台运营商龙头之一，专注提供全球贸易领域服务。
（2） 焦点科技核心业务模式构成
公司主要提供外贸B2B 和跨境交易B2B，互联网保险B2B/B2C，内贸B2B 这四类电子商务平台综合服务，为用户打造完整的流程服务链条。
按业务行业分类，B2B 及其相关的商品贸易、商业服务行业等衍生业务是公司营业收入的主体，保险业务近年来增长较快。
按公司收入地区分类，由于公司的主要服务对象是国内中小型企业，因此大陆地区收入占比有绝对的优势，其中华东地区与华南地区为公司营收的主双驱，平均营收占比超过70%。
（3） 焦点科技财务运营状况优秀
2015-2019 年公司营业收入由4.95 亿元增至10.10亿元。
跨境通（A股上市）
（1）首位A股上市跨境电商企业通过收购不断扩大规模
跨境通是一家注册在中国的跨境电商零售企业，前身为山西百圆裤业。是首位在A股上市的跨境电商企业。
（2）跨境进出口业务多样
公司主营业务包括跨境出口电商业务、跨境进口电商业务两大类。
跨境通是兼有跨境进出口、B2B 和 B2C、自建平台和第三方平台的一个全面多样化的电商平台。
（3） 跨境通业务布局全球 环球易购领跑子公司
2019 年年报报告了如下跨境通主要子公司收入情况：环球易购实现营业收入 850,580.1 万元，占跨境通营业收入的47.6%；帕拓逊实现营业收入 343,850.9 万元；占跨境通营业收入的19.2%，优壹电商实现营业收入 587,127.6 万元，占跨境通营业收入的32.9%。
跨境通业务布局遍布全球，其中环球易购公司在欧洲市场销售占比达47.7%，北美市场销售占比达 29.7%。
（4） 品牌矩阵新型布局 仓储物流不断更新
跨境进口电商业务围绕消费升级趋势，围绕有针对性、有重复购买需求的母婴、美妆个护、保健品三大品类。
（5）跨境通营收保持平稳
财务方面，公司主营业务继续保持平稳发展，经营质量有所改善。2019 年营业收入合计17,874,236,565.6 元，同比下降17.0%。
傲基科技（新三板退市）
（1） 公司简介
傲基科技成立于2010年9 月，公司深耕设计研发打造自主跨境品牌。傲基科技曾于2015-2019 年在新三板上市，是最早国内直接上市的跨境电商公司。
于 2019 年9 月递交过科创板招股书，但又在2020年4 月主动撤单暂停冲击上市。
（2） 公司业务以第三方平台B2C为主，线下形式占比较少，品牌自主研发是特色
公司专注于自主品牌的产品设计与研发，主营第三方平台B2C 跨境电商出口业务。
多项产品获得了包括德国红点设计奖和汉诺威工业设计奖在内的等多项国际性奖项。
公司主要以线上B2C 销售模式为主，线下渠道营收占比较低仅不到 5%。
（3） 欧洲、北美、亚洲为前三大主要出口销售市场
欧洲和北美两市场收入占比超90%，其中欧洲为第一大市场，占比约 56.1%，北美占比约35.2%。近年来全球各市场营收占比起伏微小，较为稳定。
（4） 公司产品品类孵化成熟带动业绩向好
销售方面包括代理产品及自有品牌，经营品类涵盖科技消费数码电子系列、摄影器材类、时尚服装类、车载类和家居类等。其中科技消费类产品为公司主要品类，占比约60%-65%。
公司通过空运、海运、本地配送等方式委托第三方物流供应商将货物安排到海外指定仓库。
（5）公司毛利率稳重上升，收入规模保持持续增长
在行业增长的背景下，公司加大自主品牌产品研发及市场开拓力度。
天泽信息（A股上市，子公司有棵树）
（1）有棵树：跨境电商业务覆盖范围较广，曾于新三板正式挂牌
深圳市有棵树科技股份有限公司是一家同时覆盖进口和出口的跨境电商企业，创立于2010年，注册资本为2.5 亿元人民币。
有棵树曾于2016 年 3 月正式在新三板挂牌，随后于2017 年9 月期间退市。
（2） 深度布局跨境电商全产业链，销售主要依托于B2C模式
有棵树致力于构建全球商品贸易流通体系，B2C 销售为公司跨境出口业务的主要商业模式。
公司主要利用第三方网购平台进行B2C 销售，业务主要分为跨境出口和海淘两大板块。
欧洲、美洲、亚洲（除中国大陆）为公司前三市场，2019 年 Q2-Q4 期间其市场销售额为 17.1亿元、8.6 亿元和 3.0亿元；占营收比重分别为 55%、27%和 9%。
（3）公司产品品类齐全，电子类产品收入占比最高增速最快
公司主营产品总计19 大类，3000种小类，覆盖 3C，户外，家居，汽配等多种产品。
2019年3C 占比总收入 28%、家居用品占比总收入 24%、汽配、体育用品占比总收入 19%。
有棵树与世界各国近百家物流服务进行深度合作，全面覆盖“海陆空铁”四大运输模式，是跨境电商中首家使用铁路作为运输方式的企业。截至2018 年公司 B2C 出口业务共有 15家仓库，9 家为海外仓。
（4）跨境出口业务为公司业绩的主要来源支撑其快速增长
财务方面，剔除进口业务部分，有棵树2016 年实现营收 15.04 亿元，同比增长 133%，归母净利润0.91 亿元，同比增长 112%。
赛维电商（新三板退市）
（1）公司专营跨境出口B2C业务，主要依托第三方电商平台
赛为电商是专注跨境出口B2C 业务、品牌建设和供应链管理的电子商务公司。
跨境出口B2C 零售业务方面，公司主要依托 Amazon、Wish、 eBay、速卖通等的第三方平台，辅以自营的 DressLink、CNDirect 等垂直电子商务销售平台及华成云商分销平台。

title: 在Temu选品上，这个宝藏网站一定要知道
page_body:
说到选品，大部分Temu卖家们，都会选择去查看数据、榜单。
但很多人不知道的是，除了看各种静态、枯燥的数字外，我们还能通过潜入海外用户最常光顾的线上社区中，来获得更直接、生动的选品思路。
接下来，我就来给大家介绍一下，海外用户的冲浪宝地—— Reddit 。
有些卖家可能听过这个平台，感觉这个平台， 好像和选品没啥关系 ，但是，等我详细讲完，你一定会有新思路。
Reddit是一个社区类的社交平台，它有点类似于我们的贴吧，用户可以创造和管理“Subreddit”（话题），以兴趣爱好为引子，将用户聚集到一起。
截至2025年第一季度，Reddit的日活跃用户数，已经 突破了1亿 。
对于咱们Temu卖家而言，我们可以通过观察用户的讨论内容，来定位用户的需求，从而确定选品思路。
先来给大家推荐几个能获得选品思路的Subreddit。
1、r/Frugal（节俭）
在这个社区，用户们会讨论低价产品、省钱购物等话题。对于Temu卖家而言，是非常好的选品开拓地点。
而Temu本身作为一个相对低价的平台，客户又以偏年轻的群体为主，所以，基于此选出来的产品，在需求和客户画像的匹配度上，也会非常吻合。
2、r/BuyItForLife（人生必买物品）
在这个社区，用户会分享那些买了不会后悔，且能用很久的优质商品。
这里的用户，会更加重视产品的品质和耐用性。
从中，我们可以了解用户在产品的使用上，存在什么痛点。
3、具体品类
r/MakeupAddiction（化妆热）——用户会分享美妆产品的种草和拔草经验、购物心得等。
r/FrugalFemaleFashion（省钱的女性时装）——用户会分享时尚单品、晒单评价等。
r/DesignMyRoom（设计我的房间）——用户们会分享他们的空间设计案例、使用产品等。
除了选品之外，我们还能从reddit中，获得一些其它有价值的信息。
1、获取市场趋势和消费者反馈
例如在r/TemuThings社区中，用户会分享他们对Temu产品的评价和购物体验。
这种产品反馈 对于工厂型卖家来说，会非常有帮助 。
2、文化产品的设计
Reddit还有另外一个特点，就是它的“梗文化”风气。
咱们Temu卖家可以通过相关的subreddit，例如r/funny、r/memes等，来了解海外目前火什么，并制作相关的POD产品。
这对 做定制、JIT的Temu卖家，能够很好的挖掘一些海外流行，而平台内同质化低的爆款元素 。
对于定制、JIT的店铺矩阵卖家，现在Temu管控在加严，记得一定要做好店铺的IP隔离，建议可以用紫鸟浏览器。
紫鸟浏览器来做IP隔离，有个很大的优势，就是联系买手，不用单独配备手机，可以直接电脑远程登录Temu卖家客户端。
而其他大部分的IP隔离浏览器，都不支持这一功能，想实现彻底的IP隔离，只能电脑登录Temu网页后台，联系买手只能靠手机。
通过Reddit来获取选品思路，是一条更加有趣且生动的调研方式，而且，不同于通过数据榜单等跟卖的方式。
但它也存在一些缺点，例如社区偏见、信息准确性有限等问题，这也就需要我们Temu卖家自身做好甄别。
当然，明月想提醒大家的是，也不要完全依赖于Reddit的信息，它可以作为我们的一个选品灵感来源， 但别忘了借助数据分析进行辅助判断 ，做好前期的测款动作。

title: 哈佛大学下属的全球顶尖商学院-百度百科
page_body:
哈佛大学下属的全球顶尖商学院
哈佛商业学校（HBS）成立于1908年，是 哈佛大学 下属的全球顶尖商学院，位于美国波士顿。其以 案例教学法 、沉浸式学习环境和紧密的校友网络著称  [2-3]  [5] 。HBS提供全日制MBA、博士（DBA）、高管教育及在线证书课程，注重培养学术研究与全球实践结合的领导者  [2]  [5] 。学院拥有86,000名校友，覆盖全球51个国家  [4]  [6] ，并在 拉丁美洲 等地设立研究中心，推动区域商业研究与实践  [1] 。2024级MBA学生中，国际生占比38%，案例研究中46%为全球案例  [4] 。
成立时间 1908年  [2]
年度预算 1亿美元（含3,000万教学研究经费）  [2]
国际生比例 38%（2024级MBA）  [4]
录取要求 TOEFL≥109分  [2]
校区位置 波士顿  [4-5]
知名校友 乔治·W·布什 、 赵小兰  [2]
目录

学术项目
MBA项目 ：两年制全日制课程，采用第一学年必修课与第二学年专业选修课模式，强调案例教学与互动学习  [2]  [5] 。
博士项目 ：涵盖七个领域，重点培养学术研究人才  [5] 。
高管教育 ：面向经验丰富的管理者，提供全球领导力课程  [5] 。
在线课程 ：由获奖教师授课，50%参与者为国际学员  [4] 。
全球影响力
拉丁美洲研究 ：拉丁美洲研究中心（LARC）自2000年成立以来，在 圣保罗 、 墨西哥城 和 蒙得维的亚 等地开展研究，举办活动如2025年3月墨西哥城经济不平等圆桌会议  [1] 。
校友网络 ：全球51个国家设立校友俱乐部，2025年校友成就奖授予五名毕业生  [4]  [6] 。
研究与活动
案例教学 ：2024财年46%案例为全球议题  [4] ，如2025年3月发布的Techint社区战略案例  [1] 。
学术活动 ：2025年新创业大赛决赛展示12项创新方案；2024年9月贝克图书馆举办宝丽来历史展览  [6] 。
校园与资源
校园设计 ：位于 波士顿 的校区促进师生日常互动，融合历史与创新设施  [3]  [5] 。
财务支持 ：50%学生可获得每年20,000美元奖学金  [2] ，另有专项奖学金如2024年RISE奖学金  [6] 。

title: Disrupting Class：How Disruptive Innovation Will Change the Way the World Learns-孔夫子旧书网
page_body:
作者:  Clayton Christensen , Curtis W. Johnson , Michael B. Horn
出版社:  McGraw-Hill
出版时间:  2008-05
ISBN:  9780071592062
定价:  287.00
装帧:  精装
开本:  其他
页数:  288页
分类:  外文古旧书>英文书>教育
5人买过
在线阅读本书 Selected as one of the "Best Books on Innovation, 2008" by BusinessWeek magazine Named the "Best Human-Capital Book of 2008" by Strategy + Business magazine A crash course in the business of learning-from the bestselling author of The Innovator's Dilemma and The Innovator's Solution … "Provocatively titled, Disrupting Class is just what America's K-12 education system needs--a well thought-through proposal for using technology to better serve students and bring our schools into the 21st Century. Unlike so many education 'reforms,' this is not small-bore stuff. For that reason alone, it's likely to be resisted by defenders of the status quo, even though it's necessary and right for our kids. We owe it to them to make sure this book isn't merely a terrific read; it must become a blueprint for educational transformation." --Joel Klein, Chancellor of the New York City Department of Education “A brilliant teacher, Christensen brings clarity to a muddled and chaotic world of education.”--Jim Collins, bestselling author of Good to Great According to recent studies in neuroscience, the way we learn doesn't always match up with the way we are taught. If we hope to stay competitive-academically, economically, and technologically-we need to rethink our understanding of intelligence, reevaluate our educational system, and reinvigorate our commitment to learning. In other words, we need “disruptive innovation.” Now, in his long-awaited new book, Clayton M. Christensen and coauthors Michael B. Horn and Curtis W. Johnson take one of the most important issues of our time-education-and apply Christensen's now-famous theories of “disruptive” change using a wide range of real-life examples. Whether you're a school administrator, government official, business leader, parent, teacher, or entrepreneur, you'll discover surprising new ideas, outside-the-box strategies, and straight-A success stories. You'll learn how Customized learning will help many more students succeed in school Student-centric classrooms will increase the demand for new technology Computers must be disruptively deployed to every student Disruptive innovation can circumvent roadblocks that have prevented other attempts at school reform We can compete in the global classroom-and get ahead in the global market Filled with fascinating case studies, scientific findings, and unprecedented insights on how innovation must be managed, Disrupting Class will open your eyes to new possibilities, unlock hidden potential, and get you to think differently. Professor Christensen and his coauthors provide a bold new lesson in innovation that will help you make the grade for years to come. The future is now. Class is in session.

title: Building an Open,Inclusive and Interconnected World for Common Development
page_body:
Keynote Speech by H.E. Xi Jinping
President of the People’s Republic of China
At the Opening Ceremony
Of the Third Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation
October 18, 2023
Your Excellencies Heads of State and Government,
Heads of International Organizations,
Representatives of Various Countries,
Distinguished Guests,
Ladies and Gentlemen,
Friends,
Today, we are meeting here for the opening ceremony of the Third Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation (BRF). On behalf of the Chinese government and Chinese people and in my own name, I wish to extend a very warm welcome to you all!
This year marks the 10th anniversary of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) I proposed. The BRI, drawing inspiration from the ancient Silk Road and focusing on enhancing connectivity, aims to enhance policy, infrastructure, trade, financial and people-to-people connectivity, inject new impetus into the global economy, create new opportunities for global development, and build a new platform for international economic cooperation.
Over these 10 years, we have stayed committed to this founding mission. Thanks to our joint efforts, Belt and Road international cooperation has gotten off the ground, grown rapidly and produced fruitful outcomes.
Belt and Road cooperation has extended from the Eurasian continent to Africa and Latin America. More than 150 countries and over 30 international organizations have signed Belt and Road cooperation documents. We have held two sessions of the BRF before, and have established over 20 specialized multilateral cooperation platforms under the BRI.
Belt and Road cooperation has progressed from “sketching the outline” to “filling in the details”, and blueprints have been turned into real projects. A large number of signature projects and “small yet smart” people-centered programs have been launched.
Belt and Road cooperation has expanded from physical connectivity to institutional connectivity. Important guiding principles for high-quality Belt and Road cooperation have been laid down, which include the principle of “planning together, building together, and benefiting together,” the philosophy of open, green and clean cooperation, and the goal of pursuing high-standard, people-centered and sustainable cooperation.
Over these 10 years, we have endeavored to build a global network of connectivity consisting of economic corridors, international transportation routes and information highway as well as railways, roads, airports, ports, pipelines and power grids. Covering the land, the ocean, the sky and the Internet, this network has boosted the flow of goods, capital, technologies and human resources among countries involved and injected fresh vitality into the millennia-old Silk Road in the new era.
Trains speeding along rail tracks, automobiles running on roads, flights connecting different countries, cargo ships breaking waves, and e-commerce bringing so much convenience to people—they have all become symbols of international trade in the new era, just like camel caravans and the sailing ships were for the past age.
Hydro, wind and solar energy based power plants, oil and gas pipelines, and the increasingly smart and interconnected power transmission networks are removing the development bottleneck caused by energy shortage and fulfilling the dream of developing countries to achieve green and low-carbon development. These energy projects have become the oasis and lighthouse for sustainable development in the new era.
Brand new airports and harbors, smooth roads, and newly built industrial parks for business cooperation have created new economic corridors and new growth drivers, and have become the trading routes and staging posts of the new era.
Rich and colorful cultural years, art festivals, expos and exhibitions, Luban Workshops, people-to-people exchange programs like the Silk Road Community Building Initiative and the Brightness Action program, and deepening exchanges between non-governmental organizations, think tanks, media organizations, and the youth—all these flourishing activities have composed a symphony of friendship in the new era.
When COVID-19 struck, the Belt and Road became a life-saving road. China provided more than 10 billion masks and 2.3 billion doses of vaccines to other countries and jointly produced vaccines with over 20 countries, making a special contribution to BRI partners’ efforts in fighting COVID-19. And China also received valuable support from more than 70 countries when it was hit hard by the pandemic.
Belt and Road cooperation is based on the principle of “planning together, building together, and benefiting together.” It transcends differences between civilizations, cultures, social systems, and stages of development. It has opened up a new path for exchanges among countries, and established a new framework for international cooperation. Indeed, the BRI represents humanity’s joint pursuit of development for all.
Ladies and Gentlemen,
Friends,
Our achievements in the past decade are truly remarkable, and there is so much we can draw from them.
We have learned that humankind is a community with a shared future. China can only do well when the world is doing well. When China does well, the world will get even better. Through Belt and Road cooperation, China is opening its door even wider to the world, with its inland regions turning from “fullbacks” into “forwards,” and coastal regions scaling new heights in their opening-up. China’s market has become even more closely integrated with the global market. China has become a main trading partner of more than 140 countries and territories and a primary source of investment for more countries. Both Chinese investment overseas and foreign investment in China have boosted friendship, cooperation, confidence and hope.
We have learned that win-win cooperation is the sure way to success in launching major initiatives that benefit all. When countries embrace cooperation and act in concert, a deep chasm can be turned into a thoroughfare, land-locked countries can become land-linked, and a place of underdevelopment can be transformed into a land of prosperity. Countries taking the lead in economic development should give a hand to their partners who are yet to catch up. We should all treat each other as friends and partners, respect and support each other, and help each other succeed. As the saying goes, when you give roses to others, their fragrance lingers on your hand. In other words, helping others is also helping oneself. Viewing others’ development as a threat or taking economic interdependence as a risk will not make one’s own life better or speed up one’s development.
We have learned that the Silk Road spirit of peace and cooperation, openness and inclusiveness, mutual learning and mutual benefit is the most important source of strength for Belt and Road cooperation. I once said that the pioneers of the ancient silk routes won their place in history not as conquerors with warships, guns, horses or swords. Rather, they are remembered as friendly emissaries leading camel caravans and sailing ships loaded with goods. Belt and Road cooperation is based on the belief that flame runs high when everyone adds wood to the fire and that mutual support can get us far. Such cooperation seeks to deliver a good life not only to people of just one country, but to people in other countries as well. It promotes connectivity, mutual benefit, common development, cooperation and win-win outcomes. Ideological confrontation, geopolitical rivalry and bloc politics are not a choice for us. What we stand against are unilateral sanctions, economic coercion and decoupling and supply chain disruption.
What has been achieved in the past 10 years demonstrates that Belt and Road cooperation is on the right side of history. It represents the advancing of our times, and it is the right path forward. We need to remain clear-eyed and undisturbed in a volatile world, and we need to be keenly aware of our responsibility for history, for the people and for the world. We should jointly address various global risks and challenges, and deliver a bright future of peace, development, cooperation and mutual benefit for future generations.
Ladies and Gentlemen,
Friends,
Changes of the world, of our times, and of historical significance are unfolding like never before. China is endeavoring to build itself into a stronger country and rejuvenate the Chinese nation on all fronts by pursuing Chinese modernization. The modernization we are pursuing is not for China alone, but for all developing countries through our joint efforts. Global modernization should be pursued to enhance peaceful development and mutually beneficial cooperation and bring prosperity to all. On our way forward, we will encounter both headwinds and tailwinds. We need to stay focused on our goal, take results-oriented actions, persevere, and keep moving forward until our goal is met. China will work with all parties involved to deepen Belt and Road partnerships of cooperation, usher this cooperation into a new stage of high-quality development, and make relentless efforts to achieve modernization for all countries.
Now, I wish to announce eight major steps China will take to support our joint pursuit of high-quality Belt and Road cooperation.
First, building a multidimensional Belt and Road connectivity network.  China will speed up high-quality development of the China-Europe Railway Express, participate in the trans-Caspian international transportation corridor, host the China-Europe Railway Express Cooperation Forum, and make joint efforts to build a new logistics corridor across the Eurasian continent linked by direct railway and road transportation. We will vigorously integrate ports, shipping and trading services under the “Silk Road Maritime,” and accelerate the building of the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor and the Air Silk Road.
Second, supporting an open world economy.  China will establish pilot zones for Silk Road e-commerce cooperation, enter into free trade agreements and investment protection treaties with more countries. We will remove all restrictions on foreign investment access in the manufacturing sector. In light of international high-standard economic and trade rules, we will further advance high-standard opening up in cross-border service trade and investment, expand market access for digital and other products, and deepen reform in areas including the state-owned enterprises, digital economy, intellectual property and government procurement. China will hold the Global Digital Trade Expo annually. In the next five years (2024-2028), China’s total trade in goods and services is expected to exceed USD 32 trillion and USD 5 trillion respectively.
Third, carrying out practical cooperation.  China will promote both signature projects and “small yet smart” livelihood programs. The China Developm
